convention: experience_years uses INCLUSIVE month counting (end_month - start_month + 1), matching the production convention implemented in backend/app/ml/extraction/field_extractor.py. This was adopted as the canonical labelling convention after Memory.md decisions 79-81 found that 10 of 11 non-null experience_years labels in this file were internally consistent under one of two coherent date-math conventions (inclusive-month, matching production, or plain exclusive calendar-date subtraction), while resume_001 matched neither and was a genuine arithmetic error. resume_001 has been corrected (7.5 -> 6.6); resume_003, resume_004, resume_008, resume_009, and resume_011 were consistent under exclusive counting and have been realigned to inclusive counting to match production (each resume's own 'notes' field shows both the inclusive and exclusive month counts). No extraction code or extractor convention changed as a result of this file's correction -- production already used inclusive counting throughout.
